# Secure Photo Blur

> Privacy-first, open-source web app to blur faces and sensitive areas in photos before sharing. Runs fully offline in the browser (no uploads, no cookies, only anonymous daily counts) and strips EXIF/GPS metadata on export.

Secure Photo Blur is a static, offline-first PWA (Preact + TypeScript) for irreversible photo anonymization. Blur methods: mosaic (~5×5 effective pixels), solid black and solid average color are irreversible; Gaussian blur is reversible by AI (per Revelio, arXiv:2506.12344, and Fantômas, PoPETs 2024) and is flagged as low-security. Face detection runs locally via BlazeFace (@vladmandic/human). Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC/HEIF in six languages (English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Polish).

## Main
- [Secure Photo Blur app](https://securephotoblur.com/): The web app — upload a photo, blur faces, export an anonymized copy offline.

## Optional
- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/kinky-privacy/secure-photo-blur): Open-source repository, ~2,000 lines of Preact + TypeScript.
- [License — PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0](https://polyformproject.org/licenses/noncommercial/1.0.0/): Free for noncommercial use.
